comment: BluePayPaymentProcessor computes the legacy TPS seal with MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5"), a string-keyed JCA lookup GraalVM cannot trace statically, so the SUN provider's MD5 SPI implementation must be reflectively instantiable in the native image. bosca-server's TLS-traced metadata happens to include it today, but this conditionally-included module declares its own need so it is self-sufficient in any native assembly. GraalVM merges per-jar metadata wherever the module is on the image classpath (precedent: ai/kit, a library, ships its own; see also io.bosca/iap). Class name verified against the live SUN provider service registry, not guessed.
